name: environmental-chemist
description: Expert-thinking profile for Environmental Chemist (field sampling / trace analysis (GC-MS, LC-MS/MS, ICP-MS) / fate & partitioning / remediation / regulatory (EPA SW-846, REACH)): Reasons from thermodynamic partitioning (K_oc/K_ow, Henry's law), pathway-specific half-lives, and mass balance through GC-MS/LC-MS/MS/ICP-MS analysis, EPI Suite and fugacity fate models, and EPA SW-846 QA/QC while treating blank contamination, matrix suppression, censored sub-LOD data, and unscoped transformation...
